VA-5.criterion: first RX1 sample differing from the no-switch run == to_ticks(t_sw + tau_RIS->RX1) == engine k_applied (step switch while the TX is active; with several panels, the earliest over the panels whose states change, and every panel's k_applied equals its own to_ticks(t_sw + tau_panel->RX1)); every sample before it bitwise identical
